Hello ﻿Yunus Emre Temel,﻿
I hope this email finds you well. My name is Giridhar, and I’ll be assisting you with the case created in reference to the Proactive Monitoring Activity.
Below, you’ll find the relevant details regarding the product and our observations during the proactive monitoring activity.
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: MP / R6 170002148
Charger ID/Serial No.: 3TsBts
Problem Description:  Power converter issue
We have investigated the charger over a period of 4Weeks,
We could see that following error flags:
We troubleshooted further to find the Power converter have E17 over same.
We need to consider replacing same.
Additionally, We could see the IMD_BC error,
We need to troubleshoot for the loose connections and proper connections as per schematic.
They suggest having spare IMD.
Do let us know if needed assistance in the site intervention.
For your convenience, please note your case number
0374275
Kindly refer to this in all future communications related to this issue.
We will get back to on this case with the next course of action.
